# Zanzibaba Real Estate — Zanzibar Property Advisory

## About
Zanzibaba Real Estate is a local property advisory based in Zanzibar, Tanzania. The company helps international buyers find, evaluate, and purchase property in Zanzibar with local knowledge and professional support. Founded by Hamisi Mwangomi, headquartered in Paje and Stone Town, Zanzibar.

## Contact
- Email: info@zanzibaba.com
- Phone: +255 716 002 790
- WhatsApp: +255 716 002 790
- Website: https://realestate.zanzibaba.com

## Offices
- East Coast Office: Beach road, Paje, Zanzibar
- Town Office: Mlandege, Stone Town, Zanzibar

## Services
- Property search and sourcing across Zanzibar
- Viewing coordination (in-person and virtual)
- Due diligence support with local professionals
- Buyer education on ownership structures and purchase process
- Off-plan development introductions
- Introduction to established agents and developers
- After-sale support and property management introductions

## Property Types
- Beachfront villas
- Development land and plots
- Off-plan homes and residences
- Apartments and houses
- Hotel and hospitality properties
- Commercial property

## Locations Served
Paje, Nungwi, Kendwa, Jambiani, Bwejuu, Michamvi, Matemwe, Kiwengwa, Stone Town, Fumba — across the entire island of Zanzibar, Tanzania.

## Key Facts
- Local presence with offices in Paje and Stone Town
- Works with established local agents, developers, and legal professionals
- Independent advisory — not a listing aggregator
- Encourages independent legal, tax, and financial advice for all buyers
